description.text: Founded in 1999, the Department of International Economics and Trade is one of the earliest non-linguistic composite majors enrolled in our university. At present, a complete training system has been formed, including undergraduate, academic, professional and doctoral students. In 2020, the International Economics and Trade major was approved as a national first-class undergraduate major construction point. The International Economics and Trade major combines talent training with the needs of national strategic development, based on a high degree of recognition of Chinese culture, experience and business practice, and is committed to cultivating composite and high-level international economic and trade talents with international vision, Chinese feelings and global competence, who can actively adapt to industry changes and have innovative thinking, and has become an important base for the country to cultivate international economic and trade talents. This major has always been committed to effectively combining international economics and trade with English proficiency training, and constantly deepening the comprehensive reform of the major. The newly revised training plan takes "classification excellence" as the guiding ideology, further innovates the talent training model, and improves the innovative and practical talent classification training mode. Students in this major not only have a solid theoretical knowledge foundation of international economics and trade, but also have a strong academic foundation and knowledge application and practical operation ability through the introduction of advanced courses, research courses and experimental practical courses. At the same time, relying on the language training and international advantages of Beiwai characteristics, students have a broad international vision and strong English communication skills, and nearly half of the students have the opportunity to go abroad during their studies.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1, high school graduates, at least 18 years old, generally not more than 50 years old;(2) Foreign citizens who do not hold Chinese nationality according to the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and hold valid ordinary passports for private purposes;3. According to Notice No. 12 of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (2020), our University makes the following supplementary provisions for accepting applications from international students for undergraduate study:(1) In accordance with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, a person whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad and who has acquired foreign nationality at birth shall not possess Chinese nationality. Applicants who apply for undergraduate study in our university as international students shall, in addition to meeting other registration qualifications of our university, hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have actually lived in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025) (actually lived in a foreign country for at least 9 months in a year can be counted as one year). Subject to entry and exit signature).4.Be physically and mentally healthy, meet the physical examination requirements for applying for visa or residence permit in China, meet the physical examination requirements for applying for the major of our university, and ensure the normal study and life during my stay in China.5. No violation of discipline, no public security punishment, no criminal behavior and record, friendly to China, good conduct, abide by Chinese laws and school rules and regulations, respect the customs of the Chinese people.
